stable.notes: Control 0.4.0 build 32 reviews who spoke in a saved meeting. Each voice shows two or three of its own verbatim lines with timestamps, because a similarity score cannot tell you who someone is and a sentence you remember can. A voice that swaps labels with another every few segments is marked unreliable rather than named, and a wrong one can be folded into the right person after a preview showing the measured voice similarity. Needs glasses-server 6.21.14 or newer.
